verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own debugging agent (Seer), so letting users connect MCP servers for that agent to use is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows Sentry acting as an MCP client or accepting user-supplied MCP servers. The agent-tracing material covers monitoring of other agents' tool calls, which is an adjacent observability feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
